messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: multiple 5xx spikes and gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate (region-us-east-1) — alert level: P1

alice: seeing a hard spike in 502/504s starting ~1809991200, p95 token latency jumped from 250ms -> 6s, p99 is off the charts. dashboards show scheduler.queue.depth for pool-gpu-1 climbing to 420.

ben: confirmed. batch scheduler backlog increasing, many batches are huge and a few long-running requests are holding KV cache; likely head-of-line.

carla: paging SRE oncall (david-oncall). looks like HOL blocking where a handful of >8k token requests are monopolizing batch slots.

carla: david-oncall are you on this?

david-oncall: oncall here, joining. I see the same on the infra metrics. Customers reporting timeouts on generation endpoints.

eve: product-ops: 2 customers reporting errors via support. one in EU but routed through us-east as fallback. need an impact summary for comms.

alice: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) reduce max_batch_size on pool-gpu-1 to 24, 2) enable short-circuit routing to fallback_pool for >2s latency, 3) evict long seq requests with low priority.

ben: starting with conservative change: reducing batch max from 64 -> 32 for pool-gpu-1. applying policy patch now.

deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted by infra. Patch id: patch/evict-32-2026-03-15. Rolling to pool-gpu-1 (3 pods at a time).

carla: while that rolls, let's enable KV preempt eviction for requests flagged low-priority. runbook: `scheduler.eviction.threshold=0.75` and `scheduler.eviction.mode=preemptive`.

ben: applied temporary eviction toggle on pool-gpu-1: `curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/v1/patch -d '{"scheduler.eviction.mode":"preemptive"}'` -> 200 OK.

alice: adding a routing rule to route requests with seq_length>4000 to fallback smaller model variant (cpu-backed) to avoid HOL in GPU pool.

carla: logs show many 5xx are `rpc: deadline exceeded` from runtime batching layer. sample log: ```[runtime] warn: batch execute timeout after 12s, batch_id=0x7a3c, head_req_id=abcd-1234, batch_size=48```

ben: that matches — long head requests cause the rest to wait, hitting gateway deadlines. eviction and smaller batches should reduce queue head blocking.

david-oncall: mitigation timeline so far: 1809991275 reduce batch_size -> 32; 1809991310 enable eviction; 1809991340 add routing rule for >4000 tokens to fallback. monitoring now.

alice: metrics update: scheduler.queue.depth fell from 420 -> 160 within 3 minutes of batch_size change. p95 latency down to ~900ms. 5xx rate trending down but still elevated.

eve: customers impacted: Support ticket #1428 (enterprise customer A) reported timeouts for sustained requests; investigating whether any data loss. advising they may see degraded throughput; prepping short note.

carla: plan B if it resurges: 1) pause incoming traffic to pool-gpu-1 (panic-button route), 2) shift more traffic to dedicated reserved pool, 3) force-evict any in-progress low-priority batches.

ben: adding a temporary rate limit: `/v1/generate` per-key QPS lowered to 0.8x for non-enterprise keys in us-east to reduce headroom pressure. applied via gateway.

deploy-bot: Roll completed for patch/evict-32-2026-03-15. All pods updated.

alice: observing continued improvement. p50/p95 stabilizing. some 5xx still from a handful of requests that timed out prior to eviction.

david-oncall: marking incident as under mitigation. assigning follow-up action: schedule a post-incident runbook update to add automatic detection of long-sequence HOL (rule: if batch_hold_seconds > 5s && head_seq_length > 3000 then auto-route).

carla: capturing notes for postmortem. also recommend increasing default short-circuit route capacity and adding a slow-request heatmap to dashboards.

eve: customer comms: sending an update to affected customers with summary and mitigation steps; follow-on when postmortem is ready.

alice: minor housekeeping: created support ticket link: https://redwood-support.internal/tickets/1428 and pinned runbook section.

incident-bot: Incident P1 (1809991234) status: mitigated -> monitoring. total duration active: ~18 minutes. owners: ben, carla, david-oncall.

david-oncall: leaving a handoff note: I'll follow up on long-term fixes tomorrow AM (auto-evict heuristics + alert tuning). handing to ben for follow-up tasks.

ben: ack. I'll lead the postmortem and schedule a config rollback window if needed.

carla: thumbs up. adding action items: 1) implement auto-route rule for >3000 tokens (owner: ben), 2) update runbook with eviction knobs and exact CLI commands (owner: carla), 3) add heatmap to console (owner: alice).

alice: closing thread for now, will reopen if regression. thanks all. :thumbsup:
